interactions.target_raw: Isoform 8 of Glutamate receptor ionotropic, NMDA 1
interactions.note: The epitope of Fab29 of the GluN1b-GluN2A ATD construct was determined from the crystal structure of the complex with zinc bound at N2A, solved by molecular replacement. The NMDA receptor construct is composed of Xenopus laevis GluN1b amino-terminal domain (ATD) and rat GluN2A ATD tethered by a linker containing 57 hydrophilic amino acid residues (57-link) with no predicted secondary structure and three Asn-linked glycosylation sites with an intention to further assist secretion. The Xenopus GluN1b, a splice variant with 21 amino acids encoded by Exon 5, was chosen over the Xenopus GluN1a for its permissiveness to high-resolution crystallography. 57-Link and purification tags were removed by thrombin digestion, and the GluN1b-GluN2A ATD proteins were complexed to Fab fragments of the immunoglobulin that recognizes the GluN1 ATD.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.91 angstroms
